verdict.rationale: LibreChat's own documentation includes a dedicated "User Memory" feature page, so a first-party memory capability exists. The pack contains only that page title, with no detail on how memory is written, recalled, or persisted. File-based RAG is a different capability and is not credited here. Missing for 10: evidence of durable cross-session persistence, evidence that the assistant writes to and recalls from memory automatically, user controls for viewing or editing memories, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an everyday user, the assistant remembers me across sessions — durable long-term memory it can write to and recall from automatically
